https://sdmx.oecd.org/public/rest/data/OECD.SDD.STES,DSD_STES@DF_FINMARK,4.0/KOR.M.IR3TIB+IRLT.PA._Z._Z._Z._Z.N?startPeriod=2025-10&endPeriod=2026-10&format=csvfile.
The query window keeps it small; no bytes were edited.

Publisher: OECD, Main Economic Indicators, Financial market dataflow

OECD; https://www.oecd.org/en/about/terms-conditions.html.

The fixture tests original BIFF layout, period labels and column identity; it is
not a current production dataset. Other source samples in tests are synthetic.
